_comment: Pinned upstream sources and what the app's viewer data matches. Compared 2026-11-17 against the copies under reference/the-open-book/upstream.

comparison.outline: Edge_Cuts gerber matches the viewer outline; only the 4 corner-arc midpoints differ because gerber arcs are encoded differently.
comparison.drills: 126 plated drills match the viewer source by diameter and count (59 x 0.305, 11 x 0.3, 6 x 0.4 vias; 14 x 1.3, 32 x 0.5, 4 x 2.5 pads); 9 non-plated drills match.
comparison.padCopper: 159 pad-copper checks (every pad except the 43 Pico SMD pads; plated pads on both layers) land within 0.02 mm of a flash in the F_Cu and B_Cu gerbers. The 43 Pico SMD pads (U1 pads 1-43) sit exactly 0.9 mm further out in the gerbers: in x for pads 1-40, in y for the debug pads 41-43. The viewer shows the source's Pico pads. This is checked by tests/test_gerber_accuracy.py.
comparison.conclusion: Outline, mounting holes, drills and 159 pad checks agree. One difference found: the Pico footprint's SMD pads are 0.9 mm further out in the C1-05 gerbers than in the C1-06-labelled source. Copper traces and silkscreen were not compared.

comparison.elements: Same 20 elements, libraries and packages except R1 (0603 in C2-02, 0402 in C2-03).
comparison.layout: Every element and the outline are shifted by (0.254, 5.08) mm; the board size is the same, 17.272 x 23.876 mm.
comparison.notChecked: Copper traces, polygons and any pulldown footprint.
